title: Pentagon press release denying the Kandahar giant story

tellings.quote: that I saw something that looked like an official like press release from the Pentagon saying the Kandahar giant story is not true.

plain: The Kandahar giant story says American troops in Afghanistan fought and captured a twelve-foot giant near the city of Kandahar. A guest named Tim Alberino, who discusses the story with Jesse Michels, says he saw something that looked like an official Pentagon press release saying "the Kandahar giant story is not true." He brings it up as a sign that the military took notice of the tale, though he does not say when the release appeared.
